task.title: To launch the X-Author Contracts add-in

note.p: Don't confuse the Microsoft Word Insert option with the Mac menu bar Insert option. Going to Mac Menu bar > Add-ins > My Add-ins does not list the Apttus X-Author add-in.

step.cmd: Choose X-Author Contracts from the list of add-ins displayed in the drop-down. Apttus X-Author loads in a new pane to the right of the document window.
